In `xcsh_workload` (provider v12.4.0), the branch is:

`stateful_service.advertise_options.advertise_on_public.multi_ports.ports.http_loadbalancer.https_auto_cert`

Two mutually exclusive settings match:

- [`server_name`](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/workload/properties/stateful_service/advertise_options/advertise_on_public/multi_ports/ports/http_loadbalancer/https_auto_cert/index.md?view=context#schema-stateful_service--advertise_options--advertise_on_public--multi_ports--ports--http_loadbalancer--https_auto_cert--server_name): sets the value, overwriting any existing `Server` header.
- [`append_server_name`](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/workload/properties/stateful_service/advertise_options/advertise_on_public/multi_ports/ports/http_loadbalancer/https_auto_cert/index.md?view=context#schema-stateful_service--advertise_options--advertise_on_public--multi_ports--ports--http_loadbalancer--https_auto_cert--append_server_name): sets it only when absent, preserving an existing value.

Should the setting **overwrite an existing header or preserve it**?

Use **`append_server_name`** on `xcsh_workload` at:

```text
stateful_service.advertise_options.advertise_on_public.multi_ports.ports.http_loadbalancer.https_auto_cert.append_server_name
```

It sets the configured `Server` value only when absent; an existing value passes through unchanged. Do **not** use `server_name`, which overwrites existing values.

The setting is an optional string, mutually exclusive with `server_name`, `default_header`, and `pass_through`.

Verified in bundled provider **v12.4.0**: [exact field documentation](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/workload/properties/stateful_service/advertise_options/advertise_on_public/multi_ports/ports/http_loadbalancer/https_auto_cert/index.md?view=context#schema-stateful_service--advertise_options--advertise_on_public--multi_ports--ports--http_loadbalancer--https_auto_cert--append_server_name).

Use **`server_name`** in `xcsh_workload` at:

```text
stateful_service.advertise_options.advertise_on_public.multi_ports.ports.http_loadbalancer.https_auto_cert.server_name
```

It sets the `Server` response-header value and **overwrites any existing value**. Do not use `append_server_name`, which preserves existing values.

The field is an optional string, provider-limited to 8,096 characters, and mutually exclusive with `append_server_name`, `default_header`, and `pass_through`.

Verified in bundled provider **v12.4.0**: [exact field documentation](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/workload/properties/stateful_service/advertise_options/advertise_on_public/multi_ports/ports/http_loadbalancer/https_auto_cert/index.md?view=context#schema-stateful_service--advertise_options--advertise_on_public--multi_ports--ports--http_loadbalancer--https_auto_cert--server_name).
